name: EnforcAR
tagline: AR glasses that scan licence plates in view and flag vehicles with warrants or stolen reports.
problem: Officers check plates manually in high-pressure situations.
solution: Smart glasses scan the field of view for plates and list each with database flags; a crop mode anchors one plate in 3D to track it.
demo_moment: Team-described: look down a street and see flagged plates.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Snap AR” among 122 submissions.

lessons: Name the user whose hands are busy.
